changeSet.author: paystack
changeSet.comment: Add transaction count-based discount feature - no schema changes needed, just documentation
changeSet.sql: -- Default: 50 daily transactions = 5% discount (can be modified later) INSERT INTO m_discount_rule (name, description, rule_type, rule_parameters, is_active, priority, created_by, created_on_utc, last_modified_by, last_modified_on_utc) VALUES ( 'Account-Level Transaction Count-Based Fee Discounts', 'Apply discount when account reaches 50 transactions in a day (5% discount)', 'TRANSACTION_COUNT', '{"thresholdCount": 50, "periodType": "DAILY", "directionType": "ALL", "discountPercentage": 5.00, "includeReversed": false}', true, -- Active by default 0, 1, -- System user NOW(), 1, -- System user NOW() );

-- Transaction Count-Based Discount Feature -- ====================================== -- -- This feature allows configuring discount rules based on account transaction counts -- within specified periods (daily, monthly, quarterly). -- -- Rule Type: TRANSACTION_COUNT -- Category: ACCOUNT_ACTIVITY -- -- Required Parameters: -- - thresholdCount: Minimum number of transactions required (e.g., 50) -- - periodType: Counting window - DAILY, MONTHLY, QUARTERLY -- - directionType: Transaction direction - INFLOW, OUTFLOW, ALL -- - discountPercentage: Discount percentage to apply (0 < p <= 100) -- -- Optional Parameters: -- - includeReversed: Whether to include reversed transactions (default: false) -- -- Usage: -- 1. Create a discount rule with rule_type = 'TRANSACTION_COUNT' -- 2. Set rule_parameters JSON with the above parameters -- 3. Assign to specific charges (charge-specific) or products (generic fallback) -- 4. The engine will automatically count transactions and apply discounts when thresholds are met -- -- Examples: -- - 50 daily transactions = 5% discount -- - 100 monthly inflow transactions = 10% discount -- - 500 quarterly transactions = 15% discount -- -- The system automatically handles period resets (no manual counter management needed) -- and supports both charge-specific and generic product-level rules.
